description: This file defines a React component for a PIN change form, utilizing Formik for form state management and Yup for validation. It includes form fields for entering and confirming a new PIN, validation logic, and submission handling that calls an external function to change the PIN.

methods.name: InnerForm
methods.description: React functional component rendering the PIN change form fields and submit button.

methods.name: mapPropsToValues
methods.description: Maps outer component props to initial form values.

methods.name: validationSchema
methods.description: Defines validation rules for PIN and confirmation PIN fields using Yup.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls external changeCardPin function, and updates form status.
